summary: The diff adds src/textkit/truncate.py (private _boundary_head scanning range(room, -1, -1) with str.isspace(), plus public truncate with eager ValueError validation, no-op check, then rstrip + ellipsis), re-exports truncate from src/textkit/__init__.py with __all__ kept alphabetical, and adds tests/test_truncate.py with the seven test functions the plan names. The bugs pass traced every acceptance-criterion input (criteria 2 through 16, including the index-room whitespace boundary, tab/newline boundaries, empty and multi-character ellipsis, and the ("", 0) validation-order case) through the code and found each yields the specified result; text[room] indexing is safe because the no-op check guarantees len(text) > width >= room, and the result length bound holds since head is at most room characters before rstrip. The security pass found nothing: the function is pure string manipulation with no I/O, subprocess, or external input handling. The compliance pass found the three touched files exactly match the plan's list, test names and parametrizations match the plan's Proof section, docstrings and the ValueError message match the Design section, and the check record shows make test (41 passed, which equals the 19 pre-existing tests plus the 22 new ones) and make lint both exiting 0; the plan's three python -c proof commands and git status --porcelain are not in the check record, but the criteria they prove (1, 18, 19) are directly evidenced by the diff itself, so no finding is raised. The change is fit to merge.
